messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-04-18] standup/boreal/2025-04-18: Deploys to the event bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-06-19] standup/boreal/2025-06-19: As before, webhooks needs the event-bus to work.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11: If the event bus is down, the notification service is down: it relies on it for delivery events.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2: If the bus is down, the webhooks service is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-12-29] standup/dune/2025-12-29: Observation from team Dune: after the client rollout, the event-bus' request volume halved.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-09-24] standup/atlas/2025-09-24: Ledger deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2025-02-18] standup/ember/2025-02-18: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: Boreal looks after the bus.
- [2026-06-01] standup/ember/2026-06-01: For newcomers: the deploy window for the reporting service is still on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-08-25] standup/atlas/2025-08-25: New deploy window for Ledger: on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19: The job scheduler's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. The old slot (Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for the billing API: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season).
- [2025-12-29] standup/cinder/2025-12-29: Reminder: auth-gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23-2: Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-17] standup/cinder/2025-03-17: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-08-15] standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2: Team Boreal still owns the bus, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-09-03] standup/cinder/2025-09-03: New deploy window for the product catalog: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-06-06] standup/ember/2025-06-06: Decided in today's standup: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, since the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2026-01-22] standup/atlas/2026-01-22: The product catalog deploy window (unchanged): on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.

Question: When can the event-bus be deployed?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: When can the event-bus be deployed?

Memory entries about event bus deploy windows:
- [2025-04-18] standup/boreal/2025-04-18: Deploys to the event bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.

No later entry supersedes this. The handover to Atlas (2025-11-24) doesn't mention deploy windows. So the answer: Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
